svg.text: Every tzdata release, 1993–2026: the identifier namespace of the IANA time zone database, and what it never puts down.
340 canonical zones — the names it still stands behind
257 compatibility links — 43% of the namespace is names it has superseded
What it changes, and what it will not
One tick per release. Each exists because the data behind the names was corrected.
272 releases in 33 years. 46 of the 53 whose NEWS carries section headings report a change to timestamps; 5 report a change to a zone name.
647 identifiers have ever existed; 50 were withdrawn, 49 of them before 1999. RFC 6557, which governs this database, gives three criteria for adding a name and for changing
what one means. It gives no procedure for removing one.
data.iana.org/time-zones/releases/ · 272 releases parsed · SHA-256 in sources/MANIFEST.json · Error as Method, 2026-08-13
